slides.say: A component deep in the tree can read context with use context.
Pass the context itself to use context. It returns the value from the closest provider above.

slides.text: It’s a Hook: call it at the top level, not in loops or conditions.
slides.say: It is a Hook, like use state. Call it at the top level of your component, not inside loops or conditions.

slides.text: Always up to date: when the provided value changes, readers re-render.
slides.say: The value is always up to date. When the provider gets a new value, React re-renders the components that read it.
